title: Goal factory memory
description: memory.yaml, beside factory.yaml, is the factory's memory (ADR 0038 decision 6): short facts its runs should know. The file holds at most 8 KB and 50 entries (memory-too-big), and an entry's text at most 300 characters (memory-too-long).

from.description: The items the fact came from, as <factory>#<number>.

added.description: The date the fact was added, YYYY-MM-DD.
